title: raw item
description: One thing one person said, kept verbatim with where and when, as mull writes it and every reader of the world reads it. One item per line of a JSON Lines file. See contracts/raw-item.md.

id.description: lowercase hex sha256 of source, a newline, the url (or the locator when there is no url), a newline, and the text

source.description: the adapter that fetched the item, such as web-search, github-issues or local-file

channel.description: where the person said it: a site, a tracker, a forum, an inbox

url.description: the public address of the item; required when the item is public

locator.description: where a private item is found when it has no public address: a file and line, a message id

title.description: the title of the thread or page the item belongs to, when it has one

text.description: what the person said, verbatim, never paraphrased

said_at.description: when the person said it, as a date or a date-time; null when the source gives no date, and a reader decides whether an undated item counts as evidence

author.description: lowercase hex sha256 of the owner's salt, a newline, the channel, a newline, and the author's handle there, so one person counts once per channel without being named; null when the source gives no author

parent.description: the id of the item this one replies to

reactions.description: votes and reactions as counted at a moment, so counts can be compared over time

labels.description: the source's own labels on the item as fetched, verbatim (issue labels, flair, tags); absent when the source has none, never inferred; a snapshot at fetched_at, like reactions

signals.description: numbers the source itself gave about the item, such as a search provider's relevance or authority score, keyed by the provider's own field name

private.description: true for an item from a private stream the owner consented to, such as a support inbox; it follows the owner's lifetime for private items

raw_ref.description: where the raw response the item came from is kept, relative to the item store
